title: Senior Oracle Database Engineer – Manager
description:
Senior Oracle Database Engineer – Assistant Manager

  

  

**Who we are looking for**

  

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Oracle Database Developer / Oracle Performance Tuning Specialist with 10\+ years of hand\-on experience in Oracle database technologies. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Oracle SQL Performance tuning, SQL, PLSQL development, oracle Golden Gate, and Exadata environments and provide SME support in State Street for various in\-house ETL Applications. The job entails resolving developer problems and maintaining application resiliency in State Street.

  

  

  

**Why this role is important to us**

  

The Team you will be joining is part of our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), which is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry’s best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.


We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end\-to\-end, next\-generation financial services company.


Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

  

  

  

**What you will be responsible for**

  

As a Oracle Database Engineer and Performance Tuning Specialist you will


* Analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize complex SQL queries to improve database performance.
* Perform advanced SQL and PL/SQL code reviews and tuning activities
* Identify and resolve database bottlenecks, locking issues, deadlocks and performance degradation.
* Monitor database performance using Oracle tools such as AWR, ASH, ADDM and execution plans.
* Design, Develop, test and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers and views
* Develop scalable and efficient PL/SQL solutions adhering to coding standards and best practices
* Support database design, data modelling and schema optimization initiatives.
* Design, configure, implement, and support oracle GolenGate replication solutions.
* Monitor and troubleshoot replication processes, latency issues and data synchronization challenges.
* Ensure data integrity and consistency across source and target
* Provide production support for database\-related incidents
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
* Participate in on\-call support and critical issue resolution when required.
* Collaborate with application teams and infrastructure teams.
  

  

**What we value**

  

These skills will help you succeed in this role


* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong partnership and relationship building skills.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong problem\-solving ability
  

  

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
* Expert Oracle Programming and DDL \& DML knowledge
* Excellent knowledge on Oracle database objects (especially indexes, Partitioning and Views), database architecture and various components
* Proven expertise in Oracle SQL Performance tuning and query Optimization
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Golden Gate implementation and support
* Strong experience in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL programming.
* Strong working knowledge of Exadata and Cloud environments.
* Experience in troubleshooting complex databases and application performance issues.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.
  

  

**Additional requirements**

  

* Knowledge of Azure and Snowflake services is a plus
* Knowledge in Financial domain is a plus
  

  

**Work Requirement**

* Need to work in a hybrid work environment

**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

title: System Administrator I
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
### **Role Overview:**


The System Administrator I is responsible for the administration, monitoring, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure within a 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) environment. This role ensures high availability, performance, and security of systems across on\-premises and cloud environments.  

The incumbent will manage incident resolution, system maintenance, network configurations, and cloud operations, while delivering high\-quality support to internal stakeholders and customers. The role requires strong technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and adherence to operational and security standards.### **Key Responsibilities:**


1\. Incident \& Service Management  

* Monitor, triage, and resolve incidents within defined SLAs, ensuring timely escalation where required.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Document resolutions, root causes, and updates in accordance with operational processes.
* Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Microsoft ecosystem and Windows server environments.


2\. System Monitoring \& Infrastructure Management  

* Proactively monitor infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog,PagerDuty).
* Respond to alerts across critical, warning, and error thresholds.
* Perform system upgrades, patch management, and scheduled maintenance activities.
* Manage and optimize server resources including CPU, memory, and storage capacity.


3\. Network Administration  

* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network connectivity including static, dynamic, and failover tunnels.
* Perform routing updates, ASA licensing activities, and IP whitelisting tasks.
* Execute network security tasks such as IP blocking (shunning) and tunnel resets.


4\. Identity \& Access Management (IAM)  

* Administer Active Directory (AD) user accounts, group memberships, and access policies.

* Support identity synchronization between AD and Okta environments.
* Provision and maintain internal and customer user accounts in alignment with security policies.


5\. Database Administration Support  

* Manage database\-level access control, including granting and revoking SQL permissions.
* Support integration of identity groups with database systems.


6\. Cloud Infrastructure (AWS) Management  

* Configure and manage AWS services including EC2, S3, and IAM components.
* Monitor cloud utilization and implement cost optimization measures.
* Perform scheduled backups, scaling, and disaster recovery support activities.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure and application\-level issues within cloud environments.
* Integrate cloud services with on\-premises and third\-party systems.


7\. Technical Support \& Troubleshooting  

* Diagnose and resolve system performance issues, IIS services, hardware concerns, and access\-related issues.
* Manage service configurations, permissions, and software installations.
* Support authentication\-related issues including MFA resets and monitoring tool components.


8\. AI Enablement in NOC Operations  

* Utilize AI tools to support operational efficiency in incident analysis and reporting.
* Perform summarization of alerts, logs, and incident data for operational insights.
* Develop structured prompts for root cause analysis, escalation notes, and customer communications.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs before operational use.
* Ensure adherence to data security and confidentiality standards when using AI tools.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in System Administration or NOC operations.
* Experience with monitoring tools..
* Strong knowledge of networking concepts including VPNs, tunnels, and ASA configurations.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Okta, SQL, and server administration practices.
* Ability to manage priorities effectively in a fast\-paced, 24/7 operational environment.

### **Preferred Skills:**


Technical Expertise:
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, systems, and cloud technologies.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for stakeholder interaction.
* Adherence to processes, documentation standards, and compliance requirements.

Analytical:
* Proven troubleshooting and root cause analysis capabilities.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with internal and external teams.

### **Work Environment:**

* Hybrid work model (Work From Office / Work From Home).
* Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts and weekends.
* Availability outside standard business hours based on operational requirements.

### **Behavioral Competencies:**



* Ensures Accountability
* Manages Complexity
* Communicates Effectively
* Balances Stakeholders
* Collaborates Effectively
  


PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

* for installation, maintenance and enhancement of database platforms to support quality deliverables
* Clearly articulate design trade\-offs of availability, performance, interoperability and costs to both
* technical and executive audiences in regard to database technologies
* Provide guidance and cross training to other members on the team.

  
* QUALIFICATIONS

  
**Experience:**

* Hands\-on experience setting up and optimizing Oracle RAC, OGG, Postgres, SQL server.
* Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning SQL query and optimizing indexes and plan management to speed up SQL query performance.
* Experience in executing projects, including planning and implementing a short and long term work plans and successfully completing projects on schedule.
* Experience in implementing enterprise database and Cloud technologies
* Minimum 3 years’ experience of any of the following Linux / Unix platforms: RHEL / Solaris / AIX
* Experience with application and database performance tuning, capacity planning and reporting.
* Practical experience troubleshooting database problems.
* Experience in managing and dealing with third party system integrators and solution providers
* Experience working with clustered systems and high availability systems
* Good Knowledge of Database platforms (Oracle RAC/OGG/Postgres/SQL server)
* Good Knowledge of cloud\-based database technologies in the Azure Cloud.
* Knowledge of managing IBM Websphere Application server, Apache Tomcat, Oracle WebLogic is a plus
* Knowledge of Oracle Transportation Management, Oracle Business Intelligence and Oracle ODI is a plus
* Good knowledge of other technologies used in IT enterprise infrastructure such as server hardware, virtualization/VMWare, networks, load balancers, firewalls, SAN Storage, backups, databases, AD / LDAP, SSO and cloud solutions such as OCI. Working experience with several of these areas highly desirable.

**Technologies Required**

* Database \& Cloud: Oracle RAC, Oracle Golden Gate, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Azure cloud databases.
* OS Platforms: RHEL, Solaris, AIX (Linux/Unix).
* Performance: SQL tuning, index optimization, execution plan management, DB/App performance
* tuning.
* Infra \& Tools: VMWare, server hardware, networks, load balancers, firewalls, SAN storage, backups,
* AD/LDAP, SSO, OCI.
* Application Servers (Plus): WebSphere, Tomcat, WebLogic.
* Other Plus Skills: OTM, OBI, ODI.

title: Senior Success Guide - SFMC
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category


Customer Success
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI\+ Data \+CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.


The role of the Success Guide is crucial in helping customers to grow value and improve adoption of Salesforce. Success Guides provide proactive and reactive architecture, product, and industry expertise to enable customers to successfully adopt products. The Success Guide will engage with customers across all account segments, delivering 1:1 success guidance to Premier and Signature Success customers. With the support of AI and automation, Success Guides provide the right recommendation at the right time, enabling customer value realization at scale. They partner with key collaborators such as Success Managers, Account Executives, and Support to make our customers successful.


The ideal Success Guide is organized, agile, and passionate about Cloud Success. They have excellent presentation and communication skills in both a 1 on 1 and group setting. They have strong technical skills and are able to use their product knowledge to deliver value to both customers and internal teams.


**Responsibilities**

* Provide prescriptive recommendations, best practices, and technical advice for improving adoption
* Deliver 1:1 Expert Coaching Sessions and Ad\-Hoc Success Engagements
* Become an expert in Marketing Cloud and related products
* Help customers consistently achieve their business outcomes
* Generate positive feedback from customers, internal teams and leadership
* Mentor and upskill Guides through peer shadowing, product knowledge transfers, and strategic feedback

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* 4\+ yrs relevant experience in Salesforce MC Eco System(MCN/MCE/MCAE/MCP/MCI)
* Trailhead Ranger
* Certifications: Salesforce Administrator and


	+ Marketing Cloud Email Specialist Or Marketing Cloud Developer OR
	+ Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist
* Knowledge of Internet development technologies (HTML, Javascript, XML, API, etc.) is required
* Consultative and customer\-focused approach and engagement style
* Ability to navigate, escalate, and lead efforts on complex customer requests
* Demonstrated ability to communicate, present and influence credibly and effectively with a variety of audiences (from developers to C\-Suite)
* Ability to prioritize, multi\-task, collaborate with team members and perform effectively under pressure
* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required

**Preferred Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Validated expertise through official Salesforce certifications**
* **Understanding of database concepts and SQL**
* **Programming abilities or abilities to read code in one or more of the following languages: Java, PHP, JavaScript and AMP Script**
* **Previous experience with Salesforce/Marketing Cloud and its technologies**
* **Nice to Have:**


	+ **Experience in Marketing on Core(MC Next)**
	+ **Data Cloud certification**
	+ **Marketing Cloud Developer Certification**
